push_and_walk_forward.needs: a coal tub (Hunt) on the rails ahead of him: its back edge at the front hand socket (hand_r / hand_l) of each frame; the tub moves with him at the clip speed
push_and_walk_forward.role: work: pushes a loaded tub (the steady push 2.0-5.37 s, fitted loop)

carry_heavy_object_walk.role: work: carries a crate at the chest, slow loaded steps (fitted loop)
carry_heavy_object_walk.note: never play it without the crate: the arms are held out at chest height with the hands about 23 px ahead of the head bone - empty, that is the salute-risk shape of the pass-1/2 rules (p2f/tools/handscan.py flags every frame); frames[i].prop draws the 'crate' sprite of out/models.json over the hands

crouch_pull.role: crouch work cycle on one knee: kneels upright, bends down, grips a lump / a timber end on the floor with both hands, heaves it up (the arms swing out low) and kneels upright again; loop (fix round: was a one-shot; the whole 4.7 s Pull Radish starts and ends on the same kneeling pose - first / last frame almost identical, so it cycles without a seam)
crouch_pull.note: he never stands in this clip: it starts AND ends kneeling upright on one knee, about 71 px tall against the idle's 93-95 px, so it pops from the standing idle at BOTH ends - the miner has no kneel-down or stand-up row. Enter and leave it off-screen, behind cover / a tub, or on a cut; while on screen let it cycle

bend_over_pick_up.role: picks a small object off the floor with the right hand (frames 4-12), straightens and holds it in that hand at belt height in front of the belly, the elbow down (from frame 15; one-shot: hold the last frame; the hand_r socket = the object)
bend_over_pick_up.note: 0.6-5.0 s of Male Bend Over Pick Up (the idle stand before / after is cut). Motion edit (p2f fix round): Meshy brought the object up to the chest with the elbow out, which on the left sheet stuck the near arm straight forward at shoulder / chin height (frames 15-34, the salute-risk shape); the right clavicle, arm and forearm are now slerped from 1.95 s (full from 2.5 s = frame 15) to a lowered hold - upper arm along the body, forearm forward, hand at belt height (p2e/fix/armfix.py + p2f/af_miner.json, targets from p2f/tools/target.py -> p2f/glb/miner_hauer_p2f_fix.glb; frames 0-10 and every other clip are the bought keys). handscan's 'up' hits in frames 6-8 are the bent-over back: the free left hand rests on the thigh, above the lowered head, not raised

catching_breath.role: exhausted after a run / the dust: bent over, hands on the knees, panting (no standing cough in the free library)
catching_breath.note: 3.8-7.0 s of Catching Breath: its jog in place (0-3.6 s, root motion) is cut

headache_relief.role: dizzy / wipes the brow: both hands to the head and temples (frames 0-19), then a tired wave-off at waist height

sit_on_floor.role: rest: sits cross-legged on the floor (crib break), no prop needed
sit_on_floor.note: Sit Cross-legged on Floor, the whole 2.5 s loop

short_breathe_and_look_around.role: looks around (alerted / searching), as the courier's and the guard's

cower.role: frightened: shields the head with both forearms and turns from the threat to the viewer (ends about 110 degrees off the facing)
cower.note: Stand Dodge 1 on the rig forward (as the cast's turns and reactions). A stand-in: it opens in a boxing guard (fists up at the face, frames 0-4) before the shielding turn

back_off.role: backs away from a threat with the fists up at the chest (the nearest the free library has to hands-up: no surrender action; a raised open palm is the pass-1/2 salute rule); loop, moves backward (negative speed)
back_off.note: a stand-in: the fists are a boxing guard, so it reads as backing off ready to fight rather than as fear

p2f: pass 2, job p2f (the last credits): the rows with pack "p2f" are a further Meshy action pack on the same rig (lib/miner_hauer/final_anim_p2f.json), rendered with the pass-1/2 renderer (char/cfg_p2f.py) and appended under the earlier rows; they carry speed / root_px (px along the facing, the root motion taken out), ground snap (ay on the lowest opaque row) and role / needs / next / note / prop metadata; reverse_of = a row played backwards from the same rects
